test_title: PYST 45: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the given series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 4 7 5 1 3 2 9 1 6 9 7 4 6 2 8 1 3 8 8 8 4 7 3 7 7 9 1 (Right)

How many such odd numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 4 7 5 1 3 2 9 1 6 9 7 4 6 2 8 1 3 8 8 8 4 7 3 7 7 9 1 (Right)

Now,

Odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Odd — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16bb2ff727fe410a6efa004c2ed069ca20ac7803b65e725fefa2edabc4111023.png] Thus, there are 4 odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
